answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 716 Country: Pakistan Title: What are the best wazeefas for improving eyesight, increasing height, and gaining wealth quickly? Question: assalam o alikum sir, i am a student. sir i have 3 problems. (1) My first problem is that my eyesight is very weak and it becomes weaker and weaker. I shall be very thankful to you if you kindly send me some wazeefas or dua for sharpness of eyes and also another dua for remove glasses. (2) My height is small and i want to increase my height . sir please send me some wazeefas for fastly and quickly increase in height. (3) my 3rd problem is that i want to become rich and wealthy. sir i have heard that there is a solution of every problem in quran. sir you are the scholar and you know best what is the wazeefa for becoming rich and wealthy quickly are placed . sir please send me more than one wazeefa for becoming wealthy. sir kindly send me wazeefas for becoming rich. and sir please solve my all problems and send me all 3 above wazeefas . sir i shall be very thankful to you. sir you are my last hope . sir please help. sir please. may ALLAH help you in life. Answer ID: 716 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 556=545/B) (1) Recite the below verse after every obligatory Salah, blow it on the forefingers and pass them over your eye s: فكشفنا عنك غطاءك فبصرك اليوم حديد (2) Recite this dua: اللهم اجعلني بسطة في العلم والجسم (3) Recite يا مغني eleven times after Isha for forty days with three times durood in the beginning and at the end. Also, recite the below durood excessively: اللھم صل علی محمد عبدک ورسولک و صل علی المؤمنین والمؤمنات والمسلمین والمسلمات۔ Try to perform the Salah of Zuha (Chasht) and start your business early in the morning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
